name: emit a fixed-shape comma-separated table
definition: write one header and a set number of ordered rows combining period, severity, and count
failure_mode: row ordering or missing rows fail the table comparison

name: emit a memory-address-to-word JSON via a specific CLI pattern
definition: Read the given ELF filename from argv and print a JSON object of address strings to integer 32-bit words.
failure_mode: Entries with wrong values or missing addresses fail equality/coverage checks.
